content: Rifabutin reduces the levels of vorapaxar by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of voriconazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of voxilaprevir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or consider an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of zuranolone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces abiraterone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers; if unavoidable, increase the abiraterone dosage frequency from once daily to twice daily. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of alfentanil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of alfuzosin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of alosetron by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces amitriptyline levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of amlodipine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces amoxapine levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels of antithrombin alfa by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels of antithrombin III by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels of argatroban by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of armodafinil by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of atazanavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Atazanavir increases rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Reduce the rifabutin dose by up to 75% (e.g., 150 mg every other day or three times per week). Monitor for rifabutin-associated adverse reactions. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of atogepant by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. The recommended atogepant dosage with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is 30 mg or 60 mg daily. Rifabutin decreases atovaquone levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of avanafil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. For patients with erectile dysfunction, monitor response carefully due to potential decreased effectiveness. Azithromycin increases rifabutin toxicity by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of belumosudil by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Increase the belumosudil dosage to 200 mg twice daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A inducers. Rifabutin decreases bemiparin levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Exercise caution when discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers coadministered with benzhydrocodone (a prodrug of hydrocodone), as plasma concentrations of hydrocodone may increase, potentially leading to fatal respiratory depression. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of bexarotene by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces bivalirudin levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of bortezomib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of bosentan by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Bosentan decreases rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases brentuximab vedotin levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of brexpiprazole by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Double the brexpiprazole dose over 1–2 weeks if administered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of bromocriptine by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of buprenorphine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of buprenorphine buccal by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of buprenorphine subdermal implant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Monitor patients on buprenorphine subdermal implants who require newly initiated CYP3A4 inducers for withdrawal symptoms. If the CYP3A4 inducer cannot be reduced or discontinued, implant removal may be necessary, and the patient should transition to a buprenorphine dosage form that allows dose adjustments. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of buprenorphine transdermal by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of buprenorphine long-acting injection by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. If the dose is inadequate and the CYP3A4 inducer cannot be reduced or discontinued, transition the patient back to a buprenorphine formulation that allows dose adjustments. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of cabazitaxel by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin reduces calcifediol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Drugs that stimulate microsomal hydroxylation reduce the half-life of calcifediol. Carbamazepine decreases rifabutin levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces carvedilol levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cenobamate decreases rifabutin levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed when coadministered with cenobamate. Ceritinib increases rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of cevimeline by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of chlordiazepoxide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of citalopram by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of clarithromycin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces clomipramine levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of clonazepam by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of clorazepate by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cobicistat increases rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Reduce the rifabutin dose to 150 mg orally every other day; monitor for rifabutin-associated neutropenia and uveitis.
